caption: The drawing depicts a single round bottle with a narrow neck and small mouth, centrally positioned on a plain background. The bottle is colored in varying shades of purple, with darker tones used to define its curves and create a textured, dimpled surface that gives the appearance of a quilted or faceted pattern. The shading emphasizes the roundness and three-dimensional form of the object. The background is a light beige or off-white color, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Michael Trékur" is written in a stylized script.
title: Flask
